functionDeclarations.description: Flag a confirmed booking with an expected late-arrival note ("checking in around 1 AM", "redeye lands at 11 PM"). Verifies the caller first. The note goes onto the booking so the front desk holds the room and doesn't no-show it.
functionDeclarations.name: flag_late_arrival

note.description: A short, concrete description of when the caller expects to arrive (e.g. "around 1 AM" or "after midnight, redeye flight").
note.title: Note
